tasks.note: The main operating assumptions now take priority over payment-timing refinements. Independent read-only evidence review found that the central case needs stronger joint driver and cash support; no replacement company assumptions are adopted. The standing generic-analysis boundary is recorded in AGENTS.md and adopted decisions: shared financial changes need a reusable analytical benefit, while issuer-specific forecast corrections stay in the company analysis. Policy/proposal updates require compatible history, an evidence bridge for material departures and a sensitivity addressing the main dependency, without a historical-peak ceiling. Independent documentation review passed. The 10% starting hurdle, 9% sensitivity and historical SIXRX distinction remain adopted. Existing formulas and saved analyses are unchanged; the remaining implementation is still proposed. User clarified that supported financial assumptions may be defended: a challenge triggers reassessment, while the report explains the evidence, business mechanism and selected magnitude beside each material forecast. The compact reader edition is implemented separately. The next evidence priority is a supportable operating-to-capital-and-cash bridge: joint forecast drivers, incremental capital needs and cash retained after all distributions. Matched peers and ownership/claim evidence remain explicit limits. Reuse the simple existing formulas; do not tune shared logic to the worked example.
